item.title: Steve Spurrier takes jab at Clemson over tampering complaint: ‘Dabo, there ain’t no rules anymore’

item.title: Judge makes final ruling in Charles Bediako eligibility case
item.description: Alabama center Charles Bediako has been seeking an injunction against the NCAA as he hopes to continue playing college basketball this season. The post Judge makes final ruling in Charles Bediako eligibility case appeared first on Saturday Down South.

item.title: NCAA president Charlie Baker responds to Charles Bediako eligibility ruling
